title: Dracoliche: Static Mode
summary: The static-mode dracoliche reassembles after nearly being defeated.
overview: The static-mode dracoliche reassembles after nearly being defeated.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Cover nearby players for the necrotic breath pulse every twenty-five seconds.
Save enough resources for another push: at 1%, the dracoliche restores itself to 35% health.
Pick up the two fetid fiends that appear during reanimation.
A disengagement clears the adds and rearms the reanimation sequence.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 255.
The reanimation code toggles special ability 24 while its comments call that Unkillable. No guaranteed immunity is claimed; the three-second transition needs live verification.
Primary NPC template ID remains unverified; npc_ids is intentionally empty.
